newsitem.title: OMAN: COMMERCIAL BANK OF OMAN MERGER ON SATURDAY.
newsitem.headline: COMMERCIAL BANK OF OMAN MERGER ON SATURDAY.

text.p: A new Omani bank formed by the merger of the Commercial Bank of Oman (CBO) and Oman Savings and Finance Bank will open for business on Saturday, an official said.

"This bank, which will carry the name the Commercial Bank of Oman, will begin its actual activity as of next Saturday," the official Oman News Agency quoted CBO chairman Sultan bin Hamad bin Saud al-Busaidi as saying.
The new bank's authorised capital would be 50 million rials ($132.6 million), while the paid-up capital would be 33.3 million rials, he added.
The bank's combined assets are 216.7 million rials, making it the second largest bank in the Gulf Arab state, he said.
Shareholders of the two banks voted in May to merge. ($1=0.377 rial)
